_comment: Homelab Bridge config for server/compose.yaml (docs/SERVER-SETUP.md#docker). Copy it to docker/config.json. Keys that start with _ are comments. All keys: docs/REFERENCE_SERVER.md.
name: Homelab Bridge
_auth: tailscale serve in the sidecar adds Tailscale-User-Login. Only logins listed here get in (a refused login is in `docker compose logs bridge`). Tokens for tagged devices or curl: HOMELAB_TOKENS in docker/bridge.env.
_this_host: The container: load and memory are the Docker host's, / is Docker's disk. The image has no docker CLI and no apt, so keep docker and updates off.
_hosts: Other machines, checked from the container: LAN addresses, or 100.x tailnet addresses (MagicDNS names don't resolve here).
_sources: Other services' APIs (docs/REFERENCE_SERVER.md#sources). The config names the env variable (key_env); the key goes in docker/bridge.env. 127.0.0.1 is the container itself: use the Docker host's LAN address.
